about: Gretex Corporate Services Ltd (GCSL; formerly Dynamic Tradeserv Pvt Ltd) is a SEBI-registered Category-I merchant banker providing capital-market and corporate-finance advisory, led by SME/Mainboard IPO execution. The consolidated group also includes broking, market-making and depository services through material subsidiary Gretex Share Broking Ltd (GSBL). [1]
